nodes.summary: More overlays cover every element at least as often.
nodes.title: Monotonicity of the cover count in the overlays

nodes.summary: The number of times the overlays `O` cover the element `i` (equation (1)).
nodes.title: Cover count of an element under a family of overlays

nodes.summary: For `n = 1` (weighted maximum coverage) and nonnegative weights, the objective is submodular.
nodes.title: Weighted maximum coverage is submodular

nodes.summary: A set function is submodular if adding an element to a larger set gains at most as much as adding it to a smaller set (the diminishing-returns form, Definition 2 of the paper).
nodes.title: Submodular set function

nodes.summary: For nonnegative weights the `n`-times coverage function is monotone.
nodes.title: Monotonicity of n-times coverage for nonnegative weights

nodes.summary: The `n`-times coverage function: the total weight of the elements covered at least `n` times by `O` (equation (2)).
nodes.title: The n-times coverage function

nodes.summary: The `n`-times coverage function is not submodular (Liu et al., Theorem 1): for every `n ≥ 2`, take `n` overlays that each cover a single element of weight `1` once. Adding the last overlay to the other `n - 1` gains `1`; adding it to `∅` gains `0`.
nodes.title: The `n`-times coverage function is not submodular

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
